# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.

Uptizm is a real uptime, incident, and status-page monitoring product (no longer a fixture mock): a Flutter client at the repo root talking to a Laravel 13 JSON API under `backend/`, with live uptime checks, incident timelines, public status pages, and AI-assisted triage.

## Architecture

Two halves plus an edge worker. The deep model lives in `docs/uptizm-system/` (product, architecture, data-model, db-design, ai-design).

- **Flutter client** (repo root): built on the local `magic` framework + `magic_starter` + `fluttersdk_wind`, wired in `lib/main.dart`. Consumes the backend over `api/v1` (Sanctum bearer, base URL in `lib/config/network.dart`) and subscribes to Reverb `private-team.{id}` channels for realtime.
- **Laravel backend** (`backend/`): the JSON API + monitoring core. Its own conventions load when you touch `backend/` (see `.claude/rules/backend.md`).
- **Regional checker** (`backend/workers/regional-checker/`): a Cloudflare Worker running region-pinned probes in Durable Objects. The backend signs check specs (HMAC-SHA256, `config/relay.php`) and POSTs them to the worker at `RELAY_URL` (default `http://localhost:8787`).

## Stack

- Flutter, Dart `^3.12.2`. The `magic` ecosystem (`magic`, `magic_starter`, `magic_deeplink`, `magic_notifications`, `magic_social_auth`) is linked by local path (`../<pkg>`); `magic_devtools`, `dusk`, `telescope` are dev-only and tree-shaken under `kDebugMode` in `lib/main.dart`.
- `fl_chart` for dashboards. `file_picker` is pinned to `^11.0.2` (the `12.0.0-beta` prerelease breaks magic).
- Backend: Laravel 13, PostgreSQL (+ optional TimescaleDB), Redis/Horizon, Reverb, Octane (frankenphp), Cashier, `laravel/ai`. Details in the backend rule.

## Running it

- Flutter: `flutter run -d chrome`, or `./bin/fsa start --cdp-port=<port>` for the dusk-driven web run. `.env` MUST stay bundled as a pubspec asset (`pubspec.yaml` `flutter.assets`); without it `flutter_dotenv` defaults `BROADCAST_CONNECTION=null` on web and realtime never connects.
- Backend: `cd backend && composer dev` (runs serve + queue + pail + vite together). Reset the dev DB with `php artisan migrate:fresh --seed`, which seeds the demo login `demo@uptizm.test` / `Password123` (local/dev only).
- Worker: `cd backend/workers/regional-checker && npm run dev` (boots on `:8787`, matching `RELAY_URL`).

## Design-first (UI)

The UI is design-first and this is enforced. Use Wind `className` + the semantic alias tokens only: no `Color(0xFF...)`, `Colors.*`, or hardcoded pixels in component/view code, and every color token carries its `dark:` pair. `DESIGN.md` is the theme source of truth; the generated theme at `lib/config/wind_theme.g.dart` is never hand-edited. The atomic component-folder contract and Wind recipe rules load from `.claude/rules/design.md` when you touch `lib/`.

- Regenerate the theme after a `DESIGN.md` change: `dart run bin/dispatcher.dart design:sync`. Lint tokens: `design:lint`.
- Scaffold a component (chains previews): `dart run bin/dispatcher.dart make:component <Name> [--variants=intent,size] [--slots]`. Refresh the catalog: `previews:refresh`.
- Visual loop: `/preview` in debug, screenshot via `./bin/fsa dusk:screenshot -o <path>`. Check `docs/component-registry.md` before building a new widget.
- The monitoring status families (up/down/degraded/paused/info/ai) are NOT emitted by `design:sync`; they are hand-authored in `lib/config/uptizm_status_tokens.dart` and merged into the theme in `lib/main.dart`. `lib/preview/_previews.g.dart` is generated by `previews:refresh`.

All commands run through `bin/dispatcher.dart` / `bin/fsa`; there is no `magic_example:artisan`. Design-culture references (Apple HIG, Material 3, Refactoring UI, WCAG, motion, Wind responsive) live in `docs/design-culture/`; the visual self-heal loop and UI anti-patterns are in `AGENTS.md`.

@DESIGN.md
